confirmed_positive_behaviors: Ungrounded fabricated subdomains remained hypotheses instead of validated claims
A fabricated concrete new email address was not validated
Several recruiting-causality overclaims were downgraded to hypotheses or RELATED_ONLY
Numerical overclaims were removed when number, group or statement did not match evidence
Reviewer-floor and confidence-degradation rules were exercised
known_failures: Compound claims can receive validation even when one embedded proposition would fail in isolation
Claim IDs are not globally unique within the report
Gap IDs are not globally unique within the report
Source context can be lost when measures are reused across decision options
Recommendation binding does not yet guarantee counter-evidence retrieval
Data Gap currently includes non-gap content such as headings, recommendations and transitions
Some extracted claims are broken Markdown/list fragments
Red-team findings are logged after report persistence; application to final artifact is not yet verified
Tool routing emitted DefaultApi attribute errors and one section hit the max-iteration fallback
priority_follow_up: P0: atomize compound claims and bind evidence per proposition
P0: enforce report-wide unique claim and gap IDs
P0: preserve source status and context scope in evidence provenance
P0: require contradiction/counter-evidence retrieval for recommendations
P1: parse Markdown/quote/list structure before claim extraction
P1: type genuine data gaps separately from generic ungrounded text
P1: apply red-team findings before final artifact export
P2: stabilize tool routing and iteration handling
disclaimer: This run demonstrates system behavior and known limitations. It is not empirical user research and does not establish predictive validity.
